title: Nov 16–29, 2026
authoring: Edit this file once a week or the night before, then push. Starting Mon Nov 23 the standing split is Monday lower body, Wednesday upper body, and Friday full body, all at 8:00 AM America/New_York. Tuesday and Thursday stay treadmill days. Fri Nov 20 stays lower body (it was first entered as full body). Each day needs its own id (2026-11-23-lower), date, dateLabel, time, title, notes, warmup, cooldown, and exercises. Each exercise needs sets, reps, weight, cues, and avoid (the common mistake). Shea is 50, rebuilding fitness, type 2 diabetes, dumbbells (one pair is 30 lb) and an adjustable bench, no barbell. Keep loads conservative. Never program a bench hip thrust, a Bulgarian split squat, reverse lunges, or any move where he balances or could slide on the bench edge. Use step-ups instead of lunges, and hold a rail. Glutes are a floor glute bridge with one dumbbell on the hips, 3 x 12. Current starting loads: goblet squat / RDL / glute bridge 30, calf raise 25, step-ups bodyweight, floor press 20, row 25, seated press 15, curl 15, triceps extension 15, rear-delt fly 10. Dumbbells only in 5 lb steps. A single-day object (exercises at the top, no days array) still loads.

schedule.offDays: Rest or treadmill day. No strength workout. Treadmill days are Tuesday and Thursday.

days.title: Lower Body Day
days.subtitle: Friday · 8:00 AM · about 45 min · dumbbells + a sturdy step
notes: Keep a quick carb nearby (glucose tabs or juice). Stop if you feel dizzy or have chest pain.
After lifting, a short rise in sugar is common. An easy 10-minute walk afterward helps.
First set of each move on the light end. Slow, clean reps beat heavy ones.
Lower body today, as planned. The app had listed a full-body day; use this lower session instead.
Goblet squat, Romanian deadlift, and glute bridge are 30 lb. Calf raises are 25 lb. Step-ups replace lunges: bodyweight, and hold a rail.
Chin tucks and a light rear-delt fly at the end for posture. Keep them gentle.
warmup: 5-minute easy walk on the Peloton Tread
10 hip hinges, hands on your thighs
cooldown: Doorway pec stretch, 30 s each side
Hamstring stretch, heel on the bench, 30 s each
Figure-4 glute stretch on the floor, 30 s each
Standing quad stretch, one hand on the bench, 30 s each

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.weightNote: One dumbbell held at your chest
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest
Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out
Sit back and down, then drive up through your whole foot
exercises.avoid: Knees caving in. Push them out over your toes.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 25 lb, 3×10, all done. Up to 30 today; drop to 25 if a rep gets sloppy.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft bend in the knees, then keep them still
Push your hips back like closing a car door with your butt
Slide the dumbbells down your thighs to mid-shin, squeeze glutes to stand
exercises.avoid: Rounding your back to reach lower.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 25 lb per hand, 3×10. Up to 30 today. Don’t chase depth; drop to 25 if your back rounds.

exercises.name: Step-up
exercises.weightNote: Bodyweight · each side. Hold a rail or a wall
cues: Face a sturdy step. Hold a rail or a wall with one hand
Step up with one foot, stand tall on the step, then step down with control
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch. The working leg does the work
exercises.avoid: Don't push off the trailing leg, and don't use a wobbly step or the bench edge.
exercises.safety: Hold the rail or a wall. Add weight next time only if every rep felt easy. Stop if a knee or hip hurts.
exercises.lastTime: New today, in place of reverse lunges. Bodyweight only. Hold a rail.

exercises.name: Floor glute bridge
exercises.weightNote: One dumbbell on your hip bones
cues: Lie on your back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat
Rest the dumbbell across your hip bones and hold it
Drive your hips up, squeeze 1 second, lower slowly
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back at the top. This stays on the floor, never on the bench.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 25 lb, 3×12. Up to 30 today.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
cues: Dumbbells at your sides. Feet hip-width, whole foot on the floor
Rise onto the balls of your feet, pause, then lower for 2 seconds
Stay tall. A fingertip on the bench is fine if you sway
exercises.avoid: Don't do these on a step or the bench edge. Nothing to slip off.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 20 lb per hand, 3×12. Up to 25 today. Stay on the floor, not on a step.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear-delt fly
exercises.weightNote: Per hand. Light on purpose. Use 5 lb if 10 feels heavy
cues: Soft knees, hinge at the hips, back flat, arms hang under your shoulders
Slight bend in the elbows. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until they line up with your shoulders
Lead with the elbows, squeeze the rear shoulders, then lower for 2 seconds
exercises.avoid: Don't swing your torso or turn this into a shrug. The torso stays still.
exercises.safety: Keep it light. Neck stays long, eyes on the floor. Stop if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 10 lb, 2×10. Same weight, add a third set today.

exercises.name: Dead bug (core finisher)
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent 90° over your hips
Press your lower back into the floor
Slowly reach one arm back and the opposite leg out, then switch
exercises.avoid: Letting your lower back pop off the floor.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 2×10. Go for 2×12 today.

exercises.name: Chin tuck
exercises.weightNote: Hold 3 seconds each rep. Against a wall, or lie on your back
cues: Stand with the back of your head, shoulders, and hips against a wall, or lie on your back with knees bent
Eyes stay level. Make a gentle double chin and slide your head straight back
Hold 3 seconds, then ease back to the start. Breathe through the hold
exercises.avoid: Don't tip your chin down or poke your head forward to start the rep. This is a slide back, not a nod.
exercises.safety: Keep this gentle. Don't press on or load the neck. Stop if you feel pain, numbness, or tingling.
exercises.lastTime: Mon Nov 16: 2×10. Go for 2×12 today. Keep it gentle.

Upper body today. The chest move is a floor press, not a bench press. If a shoulder pinches, skip that move and jot a note.
Dumbbells stay in 5 lb steps. Leave about 2 reps in the tank.
Chin tucks and a light rear-delt fly at the end for posture. Keep them gentle.
warmup: 5-minute easy walk on the Peloton Tread
10 wall push-ups, or hands on the bench
10 shoulder-blade squeezes, arms at your sides
cooldown: Chest stretch in a doorway, 30 s

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor, knees bent, feet flat. Shoulder blades pinched back
Start with the dumbbells over your chest. Lower until your elbows rest on the floor, about 45° from your sides
Press to straight arms, then lower under control. Pause on the floor, do not bounce
exercises.avoid: Bouncing your elbows off the floor, or flaring them straight out to the sides.
exercises.safety: Keep your lower back gently pressed toward the floor. Stop if a shoulder pinches.
exercises.lastTime: Wed Nov 18 was a bench press, 25 lb, 3×10. Today is a floor press at 20 lb per hand.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: One knee and one hand on the bench, back flat like a table
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, not your chest
Lower slowly until your arm is straight
exercises.avoid: Twisting your torso to heave the weight up.
exercises.lastTime: Wed Nov 18: 25 lb, 3×12, all done. Stay at 25 today. 30 is next only if every rep is clean.

exercises.name: Seated shoulder press
cues: Bench upright, whole back against the pad, feet flat
Start with dumbbells at ear height, palms forward
Press straight up, then lower under control
exercises.avoid: Arching your lower back off the pad.
exercises.lastTime: Wed Nov 18: 15 lb, 12, 12, and 11. Stay at 15 until every set hits 12.

exercises.name: Dumbbell biceps curl
cues: Stand tall, elbows pinned near your ribs, palms facing forward
Curl the dumbbells to shoulder height without swinging
Lower for a full 3 seconds
exercises.avoid: Swinging your torso or letting the elbows drift forward.
exercises.lastTime: Wed Nov 18 was hammer curl, 15 lb, 3×12. Today is a regular curl at 15 lb, 3×10.

exercises.name: Seated overhead triceps extension
cues: Bench upright, whole back against the pad
Both hands cup one end of the dumbbell over your head
Bend the elbows to lower it behind your head, then straighten
exercises.avoid: Flaring the elbows wide, or arching your lower back off the pad.
exercises.lastTime: Wed Nov 18: 15 lb, 2×12, third set skipped. Stay at 15 and finish all 3 sets.
